name: Roter Alnuruf Ring Temco Volt
original_name: ロテール・アルヌルーフ= リング・テムコ・ヴォルト
source:
Star Sign: Libra
Image Stone: Tanzanite, Lapis Lazuli

A Holy Knight whose specialty is light magic.
A sociable guy who is used to treating women, but he never shows his true feelings.
He is really only good at treating people because of his mother's influence and he doesn't actually like people because he is afraid of being betrayed.
